author: FredLM
body:
I hacked in October, day 23 last year 2015 and this was a request if i could be disbanded because i really loved this server and i swear i won't hack again it was just a little play around and this is just asking if i could have a second chance because i even bought emerald because i loved this server so much. I feel very guilty and i just shouldn't have hacked, I understand if you don't want to take me back but i miss nebula, walls king of the hill. 

Thank you for your attention,
FredTheRedHead

Here is my email: marquesfrederico.flm@gmail.com
